citations.quote: Members and candidates have the responsibility of determining how often, in what manner, and in what particular circumstances the disclosure of conflicts must be made.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Standard VI.A REQUIRES full and fair disclosure of all matters that could impair independence/objectivity; VI.B REQUIRES client and employer transactions to take priority over Member's beneficial-owner trades; VI.C REQUIRES disclosure of referral-fee arrangements to clients, prospective clients, and employer.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Standard VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts + VI(B) Priority of Transactions + VI(C) Referral Fees
